ARCHIVE / LORE

What the Spire Knows

For nine generations the Ossuary Gate was catalogued as a sealed architectural failure beneath the oldest mapped foundations. Then the Gate began to breathe.

Records recovered from the lower library describe a thing imprisoned before the present orders of wizardry had names. It does not climb. It does not hunt. It waits while the structures above it slowly become part of its body.

“Do not ask what is beneath the Gate. Ask how much of the Gate is already beneath it.” — fragment, author removed from the Registry

Participation

  • Level helps, but does not exclude new members.

  • Rewards use participation tiers, not only top damage.
